entities.name: Sidelink Discovery Transmission
entities.description: Procedure for a UE configured to transmit NR sidelink discovery messages, involving resource allocation configuration based on UE state and network configuration.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: UE state where the UE has an active RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message used to configure UE parameters including sidelink dedicated configuration.

entities.name: SIB12
entities.description: System Information Block 12 containing sidelink common configuration parameters.

entities.name: sl-ConfigDedicatedNR
entities.description: Dedicated sidelink configuration included in RRCReconfiguration message.

entities.name: sl-DiscConfig
entities.description: Sidelink discovery configuration included in dedicated configuration.

entities.name: sl-DiscConfigCommon
entities.description: Common sidelink discovery configuration included in SIB12.

entities.name: UE acting as NR sidelink U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Condition where the UE is configured as a U2N relay and meets threshold conditions.

entities.name: UE selecting/has selected NR sidelink U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Condition where the UE is a remote UE with a selected relay and meets threshold conditions.

entities.name: UE performing NR sidelink non-relay discovery
entities.description: Condition where the UE performs sidelink discovery without relay involvement.

entities.name: sl-ScheduledConfig
entities.description: Configuration for scheduled sidelink resource allocation (mode 1).

entities.name: sl-UE-SelectedConfig
entities.description: Configuration for UE-selected sidelink resource allocation (mode 2).

entities.name: sl-TxPoolExceptional
entities.description: Exceptional transmission pool used for random selection in mode 2.

entities.name: sl-DiscTxPoolScheduling
entities.description: Scheduling pool for sidelink discovery transmission in mode 1.

entities.name: sl-DiscTxPoolSelected
entities.description: Selected pool for sidelink discovery transmission in mode 2 based on sensing.

entities.name: sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal
entities.description: Normal selected pool for sidelink transmission in mode 2 based on sensing.

entities.name: T310
entities.description: Timer for MCG failure detection.

entities.name: T311
entities.description: Timer for RRC connection re-establishment.

entities.name: T301
entities.description: Timer for RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: T304
entities.description: Timer for handover execution.

entities.name: Configure lower layers for sidelink resource allocation mode 1
entities.description: Property where UE configures lower layers for network-scheduled resource allocation.

entities.name: Configure lower layers for sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on sensing
entities.description: Property where UE configures lower layers for UE-autonomous resource allocation using sensing.

entities.name: Configure lower layers for sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection
entities.description: Property where UE configures lower layers for UE-autonomous resource allocation using random selection.

relations.description: Sidelink discovery transmission procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state for certain configurations.
RRCReconfiguration message contains sl-ConfigDedicatedNR information element.
sl-ConfigDedicatedNR contains sl-DiscConfig for sidelink discovery.
SIB12 contains sl-DiscConfigCommon for common sidelink discovery configuration.
UE acting as U2N relay condition guards sidelink discovery transmission procedure.
UE selecting/having selected U2N relay condition guards sidelink discovery transmission procedure.
UE performing non-relay discovery condition guards sidelink discovery transmission procedure.
Configuration with sl-ScheduledConfig establishes resource allocation mode 1.
Configuration with sl-UE-SelectedConfig establishes resource allocation mode 2 based on sensing.
Presence of sl-TxPoolExceptional establishes resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection.
Timer T310 running guards establishment of resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection.
Timer T311 running guards establishment of resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection.
Timer T301 running guards establishment of resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection.
Timer T304 running guards establishment of resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection.
sl-DiscTxPoolScheduling establishes resource allocation mode 1 for sidelink discovery.
sl-DiscTxPoolSelected establishes resource allocation mode 2 based on sensing for sidelink discovery.
sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal establishes resource allocation mode 2 based on sensing for sidelink transmission.
